Our Curriculum

Pink Impact Academy teaches the Nigerian National Curriculum across all levels, from Nursery to SS 3, preparing every pupil for academic excellence and future success.

Nursery School

Nursery 1 · Nursery 2 · Nursery 3

Early Childhood Education
English Studies (Phonics & Rhymes) Mathematics (Number Work) Asụsụ Igbo Food and Nutrition Health Habit Social Habit General Science Computer Studies Christian Religious Studies Writing & Handwriting Poems & Rhymes Colouring & Drawing Verbal Reasoning Quantitative Reasoning Summative Assessment

Primary School

Primary 1 – Primary 6

Basic Education
English Language Mathematics Igbo Language Basic Science & Technology Social Studies Civic Education Christian Religious Studies (CRS) Home Economics Agricultural Science Physical & Health Education (PHE) Computer Studies (ICT) Cultural & Creative Arts (CCA) Security Education French Language Verbal Reasoning Quantitative Reasoning Writing Drawing Craft Vocational Studies
📌 CA: 40 marks  |  Exam: 60 marks  |  Total: 100 marks per subject

Junior Secondary School

JSS 1 – JSS 3

Junior Secondary
English Language Mathematics Igbo Language Basic Science Basic Technology Social and Citizenship Education Civic Education Christian Religious Studies (CRS) Business Studies Home Economics Livestock Farming Physical and Health Education (PHE) Computer Studies / Digital Technologies Cultural and Creative Art (CCA) Nigerian History Craft French Language Intermediate Science

Senior Secondary School

About us

Pink Impact Academy, Amorka, was established in September 2015. We combine sound academics, good character and close attention to each child.

Our proprietress

Mrs Akabuogu Kelechi is the proprietress of the school.

Our mission

To give every pupil a strong academic foundation and the character to use it well.

Our values

Discipline, integrity, curiosity and respect.

News

Classes and subjects

We teach Nursery 1 to 3, Primary 1 to 6, JSS 1 to 3 and SS 1 to 3. Senior secondary students follow the Science, Arts or Commercial stream.
